meta.title: [CursorTest] [Upon #3344] Optimize qwen-moe layer
meta.body_summary: Introduce CausalLM application structure and optimize MoE, Embedding, and MHA layers with shared tensors, AVX2 vectorization, and better cache locality, claiming significant speedups.

perf_labels.notes: Test PR with large C++ MoE layer optimizations; closed without human review despite manual before/after TPS data in a comment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 6336 changed lines across 37 files, this is a very large change by absolute volume, consisting mostly of new CausalLM infrastructure and MoE layer optimizations. As a test/demonstration PR, it was closed without merge, consistent with its purpose as a proof-of-concept rather than a merge candidate.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot review exclusively flagged clang-format violations; no human feedback on correctness or performance.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce memory copies via shared tensors and AVX2 vectorized operations, yielding up to 3.6× prefill speedup (34.79→124 TPS) and 2.1× token generation speedup (8.51→17.87 TPS) per the author's manual test.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed as a test/demonstration; no human review engagement; bot clang-format suggestions only.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a large-scale C++ performance optimization with low-level intrinsics, but the PR was a test and never entered human review, illustrating the process boundary where demonstration PRs do not proceed to evaluation.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Bot clang-format check provided formatting feedback but no performance validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Author posted before/after TPS numbers in a comment with test conditions (31 tokens, 1‑MoE‑layer model), but no full benchmark script or integration into CI.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without review cycle; no regression handling occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added CausalLM application base (causal_lm, factory, layers) and heavily optimized the MoE layer with pre‑computed token assignments, shared tensors, AVX2‑accelerated softmax/RoPE/matmul, and improved FP16 KV‑cache handling.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Infrastructure and build‑system additions support the new application but are not performance‑focused.
change_trajectory: Human author added Tensor::getBatchSlice, CausalLM base, Qwen3 dense, and Qwen3‑MoE scaffolding.
Cursor agent commits overhauled MoE forwarding: pre‑computed expert assignments, shared‑memory tile computation, and minor formatting/refactoring.
No human review or follow‑up after the agent’s optimization commits; PR closed within 28 minutes.

review_signals.summary: Multiple inline comments suggesting formatting fixes (line wrapping, spaces, etc.) in qwen_moe_layer.cpp and .h.
Formal review dismissed; substantive content is only the clang‑format suggestions.
Reported 31‑token test results: prefill 34.79→124 TPS, token generation 8.51→17.87 TPS with the updated MoE layer.

collaboration_trajectory: Multiple human‑authored preparatory commits were followed by Cursor agent’s MoE optimization commits.
A bot review appeared ~1 minute after the last commit with 21 formatting suggestions and was dismissed.
The author posted performance numbers 21 minutes after creation; no further interaction, and the PR was closed 6 minutes later.
